seo.homeDescription: Makzn 7 is a comprehensive film design services company founded in 2020. It functions as a hub for facilities such as a film design house, a prop house, a wardrobe studio, and a construction workshop.
seo.aboutDescription: Learn about Makzn7: our story, our team, and the comprehensive film design services we bring to screen — from concept and research to design, construction and location prep.
seo.projectsDescription: Explore selected work by Makzn7 across film design, props, wardrobe and set construction.
seo.contactDescription: Get in touch with Makzn7 for film design, prop house, wardrobe and construction inquiries.
seo.manjraDescription: Manjra is Makzn7's construction workshop, building sets, decor and structures for film and screen.
seo.mansjDescription: Mansj is Makzn7's wardrobe studio, designing and producing costumes and wardrobe for film and screen.
seo.prophouseDescription: PropHouse is Makzn7's prop house, sourcing and supplying properties for film and screen productions.
seo.privacyDescription: Privacy Policy for the Makzn7 website.
